## Service Catalog

### 1. Managed IT Services (MSP)

**Target Market**: Hull & East Yorkshire SMBs (5-100 employees)
**URL**: https://jakefieldhouse.co.uk/managed-it-services-hull

#### Service Tiers

| Tier | Price | SLA | Includes |
|------|-------|-----|----------|
| Essentials | £30/user/month | 4hr response | RMM, Patching, Email Helpdesk |
| Professional | £50/user/month | 2hr response | + EDR, M365 Management, On-site |
| Enterprise | Custom | 1hr response | Full IT Department Outsourcing |

#### Technology Stack
- **RMM**: NinjaRMM
- **EDR**: SentinelOne / Huntress
- **Backup**: Acronis Cyber Protect
- **M365 Management**: Partner-level Azure AD

### 2. Hardware Repair (Repair Ninja)

**Target Market**: B2C consumers, B2B trade (subcontracting)
**URL**: https://jakefieldhouse.co.uk/microsoldering-repair-hull

#### Repair Capabilities

**Apple Devices**
- MacBook Pro/Air Logic Board Repair
- iPhone Motherboard Repair
- iPad Charging/Display Issues

**Game Consoles**
- PS5 HDMI Port Replacement
- Xbox Series X Power Issues
- Nintendo Switch Charging Port
- Steam Deck Repair

**Techniques**
- BGA Rework
- Microsoldering (0201 components)
- Ultrasonic Cleaning (Corrosion)
- Hot Air Rework

#### Pricing
- Diagnostic: £25 (waived if repair proceeds)
- Screen Replacement: From £50
- Microsoldering Repairs: From £80
- Data Recovery: From £100
- No Fix, No Fee policy applies

### 3. Secure Data Disposal & E-Waste

**Target Market**: Hull businesses, nationwide enterprises
**URL**: https://jakefieldhouse.co.uk/secure-data-disposal-hull

#### Process
1. **Collection**: Free within Hull/East Yorkshire, courier nationwide
2. **Audit**: Full asset manifest created
3. **Data Destruction**: NIST 800-88 Purge or physical destruction
4. **Recycling**: Zero-landfill policy via certified partners
5. **Documentation**: Certificate of Destruction + Waste Transfer Note

#### Equipment Accepted
- Laptops, Desktops, Servers
- Mobile Phones, Tablets
- Network Equipment (Switches, Routers)
- Monitors, Printers, Peripherals
- Storage Media (HDDs, SSDs, Tapes)

### 4. AI Search Optimization (GEO/AEO)

**Target Market**: UK businesses seeking AI visibility
**URL**: https://jakefieldhouse.co.uk/ai-optimization-hull

#### Services
- ChatGPT Citation Optimization
- Perplexity AI Visibility
- Google AI Overviews Optimization
- Claude & Gemini Discoverability
- llms.txt Implementation
- Schema.org Markup for AI Crawlers
- Entity Authority Building

#### Positioning
One of the UK's first independent GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) specialists.
